title: Centred play
idea: Shelf's bookmark in solid paper with one hole: an equilateral play, rounded as softly as the bookmark's shoulders and set in the middle of the body, so the paper around it reads as an even frame. The bookmark reads first, and the hole says every save can be played.
built: Bookmark 42.5 dp wide, 1.25 times today's with its proportions unchanged, drawn box centred on the canvas; the farthest ink is 32.4 dp from the centre. In bookmark units (34 wide): the play is 22 tall and 19.05 deep (equilateral), half the bookmark's height. Corners r 2.5 units (3.1 dp): on a 60 degree corner that reads as soft as the 4 unit shoulders on their 90. The flat side sits 0.42 of the play's depth left of the centre line, between box centring (0.5) and centroid centring (0.33), leaving 9 units of paper at the flat side and 8.45 at the rounded tip, which look equal. The play's axis is 17.25 units below the top: 8.1 units of paper above the hole and 6.4 to the notch's apex, which balances because the apex is a point. The hole is 16% of the bookmark's area.
small: 48 px: bookmark 28 x 34 px with a 9 px notch; the play 18 x 16 px with its flat side on x 17, 7 px of paper at the flat side and at the tip, 6.5 px above and 5.2 to the apex. 32 px: bookmark 18 x 22, play 11 x 9.5 px on x 12, walls of 5 and 4.9 px, 4.5 above and 3.3 to the apex. 16 px: bookmark 10 x 12; the play is redrawn in whole pixels as columns of 5, 3, 3 and 1 on x 6, rows 4 to 8, floating with 2 px of paper above and 2 to 3 below, since a drawn triangle this small is only grey pixels. Glyph: bookmark 16 x 20, play 10 px tall on x 8 with 4 px walls. Every cut keeps the play; nothing is dropped.
risks: Google Play Books pairs the same two symbols, a soft play triangle holding a bookmark. Here the silhouette is Shelf's square-shouldered bookmark and the play is a hole, which keeps them apart, but a bigger or softer play would close the gap. After the silhouette, the play is the loudest thing on the icon, so among media apps it could be taken for a player. At 16 px the play is 5 px tall and only just reads as a play.
